registrationTiming: Before original gate/timing outcomes and before full candidate captures. No observed gate results used to change model or thresholds.

timing.order: Adjacent control then candidate in each pair; no simultaneous thread-owned capture/replay/fit/gate load.

scope: Original default source configuration in each arm: control omits the legality policy; candidate English configuration enables it. No copied test body or batch adapter. Active spelling policy is covered separately by full 200k captures/public replay/independent reconstruction; these original gates do not claim active-policy coverage.
quietPrerequisite: Both full candidate policies public replayed and independently reconstructed after Q19 and Q18 complete gates/timing. No concurrent thread-owned bulk work during this interval.
failures: All command failures retained; execution completion does not imply quality/performance acceptance. Original 2m trigram/50k trace workloads, heap, 4500 floor, 20s timeout and variance limits unchanged.
